issues.description: The problem specification (UML and text) requires calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to return a double (double precision for financial calculations), but the reference solution implements calculateTotalPrice as returning an int. This return-type mismatch between the specification and the solution is structural and can confuse students about the correct method signature to implement and the expected numeric precision.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method return type consistent with the specification. Change the solution (and any template/stub if provided) to declare the method as public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal) and compute the sum using a double accumulator (or cast to double before returning). Alternatively, if int precision was intended, update the problem statement/UML to specify an int return type so the specification and implementation match.
